values: 爱好无常的规则恶魔，能够惩罚违反规则的敌人。
A capricious rule-enforcing Hypogean Support who punishes enemies that violate her rules.
又要我加班啊……行吧行吧。
You need me to work overtime...?
This work injury... will cost you...
How about some more interesting rules?
违规、严重违规……啊！哪来这么多工作！
Minor violation... major violation... Ah! Who signed me up for this?!
突然给我这么好的东西……是不是又有麻烦事要我帮忙啊？
This is a really nice gift. That usually means you want something.
给你无偿上了那么久班，总算有点回报了。
I deserve this. Years of unpaid help need to be rewarded.
我辛辛苦苦给你打工，你……你就给我这个？我要罢工！
I've bent over backward for you, and this is what I get? I'm going on strike!
What a perfect place to slack off!
这里的工作人员有没有年假？
Do the staff here get annual leave?
学校里根本没有这么好吃的食物！
The food at school was never this good!
“每一条看似离谱严苛的规定，背后都发生过一段更加匪夷所思的故事。不信？看看莱希拉姆的校规就知道了。”——康缇丝。
"Every rule that seems absurdly strict has an even more unbelievable story behind it. Don't believe me? Take a look at the Lyceum's rulebook." —Contess
校规第四条第五款：禁止在图书馆内练习魔法。据说，曾有位学生在图书馆中尝试爆破咒，好在康缇丝及时拦截，才只炸毁了三分之一个天花板。莱希拉姆经费因此一度吃紧。

Rule 4, Clause 5: Practicing magic inside the library is strictly prohibited. Rumor has it a student once attempted an explosion spell there. Contess stopped it in time, but nearly a third of the ceiling was destroyed.
校规第六条第一款：莱希拉姆学生见到校规书时，必须行礼致意。这条校规背后没有什么特别的故事，纯属是康缇丝无聊的恶趣味产物。

Rule 6, Clause 1: Students must bow respectfully whenever they encounter the academy rulebook.
There's no dramatic story behind this one. It's simply the result of Contess' rather questionable sense of humor.
康缇丝，规则之恶魔。如今是莱希拉姆校规书的真身，勤恳工作的打工魔，梅林的契约者兼债主——她自称，梅林欠了她整整二十年的工钱。

Contess exists as the physical manifestation of the Lyceum's rulebook. A diligent working Hypogean, Merlin's contract partner... and also Merlin's creditor. According to her, Merlin owes her twenty years of unpaid wages.
受契约限制，康缇丝只能在少数人面前现身。百无聊赖下，康缇丝选择缠着佐尔娅和雷蒙玩。据统计，雷蒙总共被她拉着下棋三千五百一十八次。从此，雷蒙就不爱下棋了。

Due to the restrictions of her contract, Contess can only appear before a few people. Out of boredom, she often pesters Zorya and Leymar to keep her company. Records show that Leymar has been dragged into 3,518 chess matches with her.
在工作之余，康缇丝也相当会享受生活。泡澡、小说、零食、音乐，一样不差。她还曾要求佐尔娅帮忙带回各地美食——当然，这个需求被无情地驳回了。

Despite her workload, Contess knows how to enjoy life. Hot baths, novels, snacks, music—she indulges in all of them. At one point she even asked Zorya to bring back delicacies from across the realm. That request was promptly rejected.
图书馆的休息室常年无人使用，康缇丝堂而皇之地将其“充公”占领，在里面摆满了各式各样的私人物品。“不许乱翻！”梅林入住后，她曾再三如此强调。
The library's lounge had long gone unused, so Contess boldly "requisitioned" it for herself, filling it with personal belongings. "Don't touch anything," she repeatedly warned after Merlin arrived.
康缇丝脑袋中全是天马行空的有趣规则，却无法自行书写。于是，她将这一腔创作欲释放在了写小说上。据说，她似乎是几部经典同人志的作者……

Contess is full of bizarre and imaginative rule ideas, but she can't write them down herself. Instead, she channels that creativity into writing novels. Rumor has it she may even be behind several famous fanfiction series.
起初，雷蒙校长并不赞同将康缇丝放置在图书馆中。直到梅林为他展示了一番康缇丝力量的妙用——例如让那些无人理会的校规立刻得到落实——雷蒙校长这才松口同意。

At first, Headmaster Leymar opposed placing Contess in the library. But after Merlin demonstrated the useful side of her powers—such as forcing long-ignored rules to be immediately enforced—he finally agreed.
康缇丝性格多变、爱好无常，但只有一个目标，她从始至终没有改变。那便是：向黑金商会的会长复仇。谨记与她的约定吧。
Contess' personality shifts constantly and her interests change often. But one goal has never wavered. Revenge against the leader of the Adamant Syndicate.
唔，你来啦，来找我聊天可是要算进工作时间里的。
Oh, it's you. Just so we're clear—any time I spend talking to you now counts toward my official work hours. Blame the new rules!
不得不说，<style="highlight"><player_name></style>你的变形术掌握能力远不如从前了。
Gotta say, <style="highlight"><player_name></style>, your transfiguration spells aren't quite what they used to be.
这地方可真不错，当然了，跟死气沉沉的图书馆相比，哪里都好。
This place is nice. Honestly, anywhere beats that dead-as-a-doornail library.

values.text: What a great place to be lazy!
